sources.title: Arrêté du 24 décembre 2025 relatif à la tenue des registres d'utilisation des produits phytopharmaceutiques et de leurs adjuvants
sources.edition: Consolidated version in force 2026-10-16; last updated 2026-01-01; Annexes I and II

limitations: Source-backed draft of Annex II A surface-treatment records only. Enclosed spaces (II B), seed/plant treatment (II C) and sowing treated seeds (II D) require separate mappings.

Fields marked optional include conditional legal requirements. A service requires beneficiary SIRET; location requires either the RPG îlot/parcel/INSEE combination or WGS84 coordinates. Time, BBCH and early re-entry details require applicability review.
Early re-entry also requires the moment, place, reason and worker exposure mitigation details under Annex I; this subset does not represent that complete scenario.
Preserve the source date, units, leading zeros and identifier characters. The displayed unit lists standard field treatment units; the source permits adapted units, which must remain explicit.
The order enters into force on 2026-01-01. Article 4 permits uses before 2027-01-01 to remain without conversion to electronic format; this draft does not impose a 2026 electronic-filing requirement.
Human review is required. No portal submission, verified machine-readable authority payload, product authorisation validation or authority acceptance is implemented.
Five-year record retention and integrity under Article 3 are source requirements, not proved by this field mapping.
